findings.description: F001 says plan_contract findings remain absolute blocks, but later acceptance text and F003 rely on unchanged v1 behavior where plan_contract can be neutralized by waived_with_reason or a plan edit. That wording can lead implementers to make plan_contract unwaivable, breaking the stated completion path.
findings.recommendation: Clarify that plan_contract is an absolute block only against streak eligibility, while existing v1 waiver and plan-edit semantics remain unchanged.

findings.description: The objective completion test says recording waived_matrix_pin_high with confirmation text then permits the lock, but F003's real C0 path only permits after every other blocker is also dispositioned and separately asserts that recording only the matrix-pin waiver still refuses. The plan does not directly prove the new disposition can be the final gate to lock success.
findings.recommendation: Add a focused offline lock test where all non-matrix blockers are absent or already lawfully resolved before waived_matrix_pin_high is recorded, then assert the lock proceeds with zero auditor calls.

findings.description: F003 says only the real sufficiency-rounds ledgers are copied verbatim, but one discrimination assertion depends on C0 round 4 having its matrix_pin high already dispositioned. If dispositions live in decisions.jsonl, the fixture plan needs that decision history or an explicit test setup step.
findings.recommendation: Pin whether real decisions.jsonl entries are part of the fixture corpus, or have the round-4 test record the matrix-pin disposition before evaluating the remaining plan_contract block.

findings.description: The user journey names no_streak_blocked as a core state, but the proposed refusal-message coverage focuses on the streak-unlocked case. C0 rounds 1 and 2 are asserted not eligible, yet there is no explicit lock-refusal assertion that the runnable waiver command is withheld below the threshold.
findings.recommendation: Add a lock-refusal test for a high matrix_pin below the streak threshold that confirms it remains blocked and does not print the waived_matrix_pin_high command template.
